summary_ja: ORNL Pathfinderについて、20量子ビットIQM Radianceの構内導入、別棟HPC testbedとの接続、Quollとの併用、simulatorから複数実機でのhardware非依存QHPC software検証への移行を追加しました。外部利用・品質・latency・application優位性は未確認です。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: For ORNL Pathfinder, this update adds deployment of an on-premises 20-qubit IQM Radiance, attachment to an HPC testbed in another building, complementary use with Quoll, and the shift from simulators toward hardware-agnostic QHPC software validation on multiple physical machines. External access, quality, latency, and application advantage remain unverified. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: ORNL Pathfinderによる構内量子HPC統合
sections.title_en: On-premises quantum-HPC integration with ORNL Pathfinder
sections.summary_ja: QPU台数やqubit数だけでなく、設置環境、遠隔HPC接続、共通software interface、利用範囲、未公開の品質指標を一体で評価します。
sections.summary_en: Evaluate installation, remote HPC attachment, common software interfaces, access scope, and undisclosed quality metrics together rather than relying on QPU or qubit counts alone.

items.name_ja: 20量子ビットIQM Radianceを構内HPC testbedへ接続
items.name_en: On-premises 20-qubit IQM Radiance attached to an HPC testbed
items.statement_ja: ORNLは20量子ビットのIQM Radiance超伝導量子計算機PathfinderをQuantum Computer Deployment Labへ導入しました。Bluefors cryosystemは4 Kまで冷却し、内部の基底温度は10 mK未満です。Pathfinderは別棟にあるNCCS Technology Integration GroupのHPC testbedへ接続予定で、既設の6量子ビットQuantum Brilliance cluster Quollと併用されます。これは構内実機の導入事実ですが、外部userへの提供、fidelity、gate time、topology、queue、uptime、classical-quantum往復latency、application優位性は公開記事から確認できません。
items.statement_en: ORNL installed Pathfinder, an on-premises 20-qubit IQM Radiance superconducting quantum computer, in its Quantum Computer Deployment Lab. A Bluefors cryosystem cools the system to 4 K and maintains the superconducting internals below 10 mK. Pathfinder is to connect to the NCCS Technology Integration Group's HPC testbed in another building and complement the existing six-qubit Quantum Brilliance Quoll cluster. This confirms deployment of an on-premises machine, but the public article does not establish external-user access, fidelity, gate times, topology, queues, uptime, classical-quantum round-trip latency, or application advantage.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIで量子資源を連携する際は、QPU仕様に加え、物理配置、cryogenic保守、network latency、scheduler、認証、calibration、fallback simulatorをsystem構成として記載する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: An HPCI quantum attachment should specify physical placement, cryogenic maintenance, network latency, scheduling, authentication, calibration, and simulator fallback alongside QPU specifications.
adoption_conditions_ja: fidelity、gate/measurement時間、接続性、calibration drift、availabilityを継続測定する。
HPC jobとQPU slotを一体予約し、data経路と往復latencyを計測する。
構内利用、共同利用、remote利用のsecurity・support・費用境界を定義する。
adoption_conditions_en: Continuously measure fidelity, gate and measurement times, connectivity, calibration drift, and availability.
Co-schedule HPC jobs and QPU slots and measure data paths and round-trip latency.
Define security, support, and cost boundaries for local, collaborative, and remote access.

items.name_ja: simulator開発から複数実機での共通QHPC interface検証へ
items.name_en: From simulator development to common QHPC-interface validation on physical systems
items.statement_ja: ORNLは、異なるvendor機へ基盤全体を作り直さずに接続するhardware非依存software architectureを目標とし、これまでsimulatorをQPU代替として開発したOpen Quantum-HPC Software EcosystemをPathfinderとQuollで検証すると説明しています。材料simulation、chemistry、AIが対象候補です。ただし公開記事はAPI、scheduler integration、failure semantics、workflow再現性、benchmark結果を示していないため、現段階は運用可能な標準基盤ではなくprototype統合です。
items.statement_en: ORNL targets a hardware-agnostic software architecture that can attach different vendors without rebuilding the surrounding infrastructure, and plans to validate its Open Quantum-HPC Software Ecosystem, previously developed with simulators standing in for QPUs, on Pathfinder and Quoll. Candidate applications include materials simulation, chemistry, and AI. The public article does not provide APIs, scheduler integration, failure semantics, workflow reproducibility, or benchmark results, so this is prototype integration rather than an operational standard platform.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 複数vendorの量子資源を利用する場合、共通interfaceだけでなく、job lifecycle、error model、provenance、simulatorとの結果比較を共通化する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: For multiple quantum vendors, HPCI would need common job lifecycles, error models, provenance, and simulator comparisons in addition to a shared interface.
adoption_conditions_ja: API、intermediate representation、authentication、queue、cancel/retry、error返却を公開仕様化する。
simulator、emulator、physical QPUで同じworkflowとprovenanceを保存する。
hardware差を隠す範囲と、物理特性をapplicationへ露出する範囲を分ける。
adoption_conditions_en: Specify APIs, intermediate representations, authentication, queues, cancellation and retry, and error reporting.
Preserve identical workflow definitions and provenance across simulators, emulators, and physical QPUs.
Separate the hardware differences hidden by abstraction from physical properties exposed to applications.
